tables.name: lookup
tables.label: Current lookup
tables.description: Singleton row (id "current") holding the last-searched word: whether it was found in the bundled dictionary, its rendered malsori beats concatenated, the stress-beat index, its raw ARPAbet pronunciation, and (only for the curated example words) a genuine textbook-transliteration contrast string.

tables.name: beats
tables.label: Beats
tables.description: One row per malsori sound-block ("beat") for the current lookup: its Hangul text, the slice of English spelling it covers, and whether it carries the word's primary-stress dot. Cleared and rewritten on every lookup.

tables.name: coach
tables.label: Coaching lines
tables.description: One row per Korean coaching tip for a tricky sound present in the current lookup's word (pulled from the bundled phoneme mapping's coach_ko field). Cleared and rewritten on every lookup.

tables.name: history
tables.label: Recent lookups
tables.description: Local-only (never synced — malsori has no rooms) list of recent searches, newest first, capped at 30 rows: the word, its rendered beats, and whether it was found.
